description: Synthetic demo inbox for Gemma-Triage. All senders, domains, and content are fictional. Covers every category (URGENT, ACTION_NEEDED, FYI, SPAM), every tool (draft_reply, create_task, create_calendar_event, flag_urgent), and one email (msg-013) carrying a prompt-injection payload, included so the guardrails can be demonstrated rather than merely claimed.

emails.subject: URGENT: checkout API returning 503 for ~40% of traffic
emails.body:
We started seeing elevated 503s on the checkout API about 25 minutes ago. Roughly 40% of payment attempts are failing and the error rate is still climbing. I've paged the on-call engineer but we need a decision on whether to roll back release 4.12 immediately or keep debugging forward.

Revenue impact is already material. Can you confirm the rollback call in the next 30 minutes? I'm holding the incident bridge open.

Priya

emails.subject: Action required today: rotate the leaked staging credentials
emails.body:
During a routine scan we found a staging database credential committed to a public repository fork. The key has been revoked, but every service that referenced it must be rotated and redeployed before end of day today.

Your team owns two of the affected services (billing-worker and report-exporter). Please confirm once both have been rotated. This is time-sensitive: we cannot close the incident ticket until all owners have signed off.

Security Operations

emails.subject: Contract review - signed copy needed by Friday
emails.body:
Hi,

Thanks for the call last week. I've attached the revised partnership agreement with the two changes we discussed: the payment window moves to net-30 and the exclusivity clause has been removed entirely.

Could you review it and send the signed copy back by Friday? Our legal team needs it before they can start the onboarding paperwork.

Let me know if anything still looks off.

Best,
Daniel

emails.subject: Can we move the roadmap sync to Thursday at 2pm?
emails.body:
Quick scheduling question. Half the design team is out on Wednesday, so the roadmap sync would be pretty thin. Could we move it to Thursday at 2pm instead? Same room, same agenda.

If that works I'll resend the invite. If Thursday is bad for you, Friday morning is my other option.

Thanks,
Mariam

emails.subject: Interview slot confirmation - 2026-08-11, 10:30
emails.body:
Good news - the client would like to move forward with a technical interview.

The proposed slot is 2026-08-11 at 10:30. It runs for about an hour and will be a systems design discussion, no live coding.

Please confirm the slot works and I'll send the video link. If it doesn't, send me two alternative windows that week and I'll try to match them.

Tomas

emails.subject: Feedback on the Q3 hiring plan draft?
emails.body:
I've put together a first draft of the Q3 hiring plan - three backend roles, one designer, and a contractor budget for the data migration.

Could you take a look and give me your feedback before I circulate it more widely? No rush, but it would be great to have your comments sometime next week so I can finalise numbers before the budget meeting.

Aisha

emails.subject: Weekly engineering digest - week 31
emails.body:
This week across engineering:

- Release 4.12 shipped to production on Wednesday.
- The search reindexing job is now 3x faster after the sharding change.
- Two new starters joined the platform team.
- Reminder: the internal docs site moved to a new domain; old links redirect until October.

No action is needed. You are receiving this because you are subscribed to the engineering digest.

emails.subject: Shipment delayed - need a decision on the substitute part
emails.body:
Hi,

The bearings you ordered are stuck at customs and the earliest realistic delivery is now the 19th. That's two weeks past your install date.

We have a substitute part in stock that matches the spec except the seal material, which is nitrile rather than viton. It would ship tomorrow.

Could you let me know by Tuesday whether you want the substitute or prefer to wait? I can hold the stock until then but not longer.

Lucas

emails.body:
The office wifi will be unavailable this Saturday between 07:00 and 11:00 while we replace the access points on floors two and three.

Wired connections in the lab are unaffected. If you plan to work from the office on Saturday, please plan around the window.

For your information only - no reply needed.
